mapper.insert: insert into dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select d.*, c.name as category_name from dish d left join category c on d.category_id = c.id where d.id = #{id}
select id, name, category_id, price, image, description, status, update_time from dish where category_id = #{categoryId} and status = 1 order by id

select id, name, category_id, price, image, description, status, update_time from dish where status = 1
and category_id = #{categoryId}
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by id
